notes: Paths are relative to the repository root, not to this file.
WHY THIS FILE OWNS THE PIN AND NOT `.python-version`. TOOLCHAIN.md's
TO-VERIFY row named `.python-version` before an interpreter existed, and
the two things that file could mean have since separated. This pin is the
CPython TaffyGo vendors, cross-builds and links into the utility binary;
`.python-version` is a pyenv convention meaning the interpreter a checkout's
own tooling runs under, which here is whatever host Python 3 the tool suite
finds and deliberately is not pinned. Naming one file for both would make a
host upgrade look like a product change.
WHY THE DIGEST IS THE RELEASE'S OWN. The SHA-256 above is the value the
release's SPDX document records for the same tarball, not one computed
from whatever a build host happened to download. Recording the second
would pin the download rather than the release.
WHY THE ASSET FACTS ARE REPEATED. This manifest owns the CPython pin and
the asset catalog owns delivery. build_stdlib.py checks id, revision, kind,
container and necessity in both directions so the repetition cannot drift.
WHY `_ctypes` AND `_socket` ARE REFUSED. The interpreter runs in a
sandboxed utility process with no network and no ambient filesystem.
`_ctypes` is arbitrary native calls and `_socket` is network, so shipping
either would put a capability in the process that the sandbox exists to
deny. The other four are cross-build hygiene: configure finds a host
header for a library the Android sysroot does not carry.
WHY EVERY MODULE IS COMPILED IN. A sandboxed process cannot dlopen, so an
extension built as a shared object is a module that would be missing at
run time with no error until an import failed. build_interpreter.py
refuses a build that produced even one.
WHY THE LINKER IS TOLD 16384. Android devices with a 16 KiB page size
refuse to load a binary aligned for 4 KiB, and the emulator most builds are
tested on has the smaller page. The flag is easy to lose and losing it is
invisible until a phone refuses the APK, so the build measures every
loadable segment afterwards rather than trusting that it was passed.
WHAT IS HERE NOW. GN compiles this pinned source with committed Android ABI
configuration and links it only into the isolated utility worker; both Android
standard-library variants are published and arrive as verified descriptors.
The complete x64 Android browser-test APK has linked, but no current APK has
been installed or run for this implementation. SP-07 therefore still owns the
device sandbox, cancellation, resource-pressure, size-budget and owner review.
